div.div: مُكَلِّبٌ One who trains dogs to hunt; (S, K;) as also ↓ كَلَّابٌ : and sometimes signifying one who trains the فَهْد, and birds of prey, to take game: see Kur v. 6: one who possesses dogs trained to hunt, and hunts with them; (L;) as also ↓ كَالِبٌ , pl. كُلَّابٌ: (R:) or كَالِبٌ and كَلَّابٌ (S, L, K) signify an owner, or a possessor, of dogs; (L, K;) the former being similar to تَامِرٌ &c. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
